hints.text: A prime number has exactly two factors, $1$ and itself. Test each choice to see whether a smaller number divides it.
Try dividing each choice by $3$. Three of the numbers, $9$, $15$ and $21$, are in the three times table. See what happens with the remaining one.
$9 = 3 \times 3$, $15 = 3 \times 5$ and $21 = 3 \times 7$, so the prime is $17$ (choice C).

explanation: A prime number can only be divided exactly by $1$ and by itself, so look for other factors of each choice.
$9 = 3 \times 3$, $15 = 3 \times 5$ and $21 = 3 \times 7$, so these three all have $3$ as a factor and are not prime.
$17$ is not divisible by $2$, $3$ or $4$, and $5 \times 5$ is already more than $17$, so no other factor exists.
The prime number is $17$, which is choice C.
